title: ITSD - Help Desk Specialist II
location: SUPERIOR COURT
field: -
description:
[under: Essential Duties] - Provides in-person, telephone, and remote technical support that includes problem identification, research, and troubleshooting for resolution of computer hardware, desktop software, and basic network connectivity problems.
[under: Essential Duties] - Provides support for staff working remotely by troubleshooting VPN, remote desktop, and other related issues to ensure staff are serviced promptly.
[under: Essential Duties] - Installs and provides customer support of printers, operating systems, standard office automation applications such as Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, SharePoint, electronic mail, and other desktop applications.
[under: Essential Duties] - Provides audio-visual assistance in the courtroom and to individual staff in using Teams or other remote-participation technology as requested by court customers.
[under: Essential Duties] - Provides multi-factor-authentication support either remotely or in-person without escalation.
[under: Must Have Knowledge of] - Microsoft Windows-based operating systems and Microsoft Office applications including Teams and SharePoint.
[under: Physical/Sensory Items] Typically performs duties in an office environment throughout the court, will routinely be required to lift up to 35 lbs. and carry computers, monitors and printers, and crawl under workstations to connect/disconnect cables and wires.

title: Senior Staff Site Reliability Operations Technical Lead
location: US, NC, Durham
field: -
description:
The successful candidate is equally comfortable running a root cause analysis, supporting an executive before an all-hands, and briefing IT leadership on site risk.
[under: What you'll be doing] - Serve as Tier 3 escalation owner for the site and AMER across identity (AD, hybrid Entra ID, GPO, Kerberos/LDAP, SSO, MFA), messaging (Exchange hybrid mail flow, mailbox, SMTP relay), compute (Windows, Linux, macOS, virtualization, storage, and hands-on datacenter and lab hardware), and endpoint (M365, Teams, Intune, Autopilot, imaging through migrations) driving root cause and permanent fixes rat
[under: What you'll be doing] - Serve as the primary technical contact for site IT, partnering with employees, site and executive leadership, Facilities, Security, HR, and Procurement on incidents, planned changes, onboarding and moves, and office and lab expansions.
[under: What we need to see] - Deep hands-on solving across Active Directory and hybrid Entra ID, Exchange hybrid, Windows and Linux server, virtualization, enterprise storage, and datacenter hardware.
[under: What we need to see] - Willingness to work on-site and hands-on (including lifting and moving equipment), join an on-call rotation, and support after-hours maintenance windows and cutovers.
[under: Ways to Stand Out from the crowd] - Executive support programs, AV and hybrid conference room technologies, or build automation with measurable efficiency and experience benefits.
